suspended_reason: The cause is loss of function of PATERNALLY-EXPRESSED, maternally-imprinted genes in 15q11-q13 -- typically a paternal multi-megabase DELETION, maternal uniparental disomy, or an IMPRINTING-CENTRE defect -- not a single-gene promoter switch. The lesion is structural / epigenetic: a parent-of-origin methylation and dosage state spanning many genes, so there is no analyzable single-gene gamma shift to read. Held per the author's rule (no analyzable single-gene DNA -> hold). This hold is a DIFFERENT KIND from Down syndrome's: Down is whole-chromosome aneuploidy, Prader-Willi is an imprinting/structural cause. A parent-of-origin (epigenetic) multi-gene model is future work, not a v0.1.0 single-switch emergence.
discipline: no analyzable single-gene DNA read -> held (author's rule). Disclosed, not dropped.
